#Packages :
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(frenchdata)
library(tidyquant)
library(fixest)
```

## PEAD Announcement Drift


#Running a small version of the project. 5 tickers over 4 periods

#1. Create an R vector of all 5 firms to test
```{r}
pilot_tickers <- c("AAPL", "JPM", "WMT", "XOM", "BRK-B") #List of the stocks to run the small test on
n_quarters <- 4 #4 quarters

```

#2. create the raw data folder for the 5 firms
```{r}
dir.create(here("data", "raw"), recursive = TRUE), showWarnings = FALSE)

#Creates a folder data/raw/ in our project
#"recursive = TRUE" creates data/ if it doesn't exist yyet
#"showWarnings = FALSE" nothing happens if the folder already exists

ff_path <- here("data", "raw", "ff3_daily.rds")
#Stores the full file path where the data is saved

if (!file.exists(ff_path)) {
#Checks whether the ff_path file exists and executes all within the brackets if YES
  
  ff_raw <- download_french_data("Fama/French 3 Factors [daily]") #Downloads the daily FF3 file from Ken French's website
  saveRDS(ff_raw, ff_path)#Saves the dowload to the data/raw/ff3_daily.rds -> prevents redownloads everytime the file runs
}

ff <- ff_raw$subsets$data[[1]] |> #Gets the downloaded table out of the download
  #The result goes into a pipe chain and saved as ff
  rename(mkt_rf = `Mkt-RF`, smb = SMB, hml = HML, rf = RF) |>
  #Renames the columns of imported dataframe
  
  mutate(date = ymd(date), #ymd() turns the data column into a real R date soR can compare and subtract
         
         
#Ken French reports returns in percent so divide all columns by 100 to work with decimals

    across(c(mkt_rf, smb, htl, rf), ~ .x / 100)) |>
